HLA Locus Information

hlaLociInfo.Rd

To get the starting and ending positions in basepair of HLA loci.

Usage

hlaLociInfo(assembly=c("auto", "auto-silent", "hg18", "hg19", "unknown"))

Arguments

assembly

the human genome reference: "hg19" (default), "hg18", "auto" refers to "hg19"; "auto-silent" refers to "hg19" without any warning

Value

Return a list:

loci

the names of HLA classic I, II and III genes, such like A, B, C, DRB1, DQA1, DQB1 and DPB1

pos.HLA.start

the starting position in basepair

pos.HLA.end

the ending position in basepair

length.HLA

the length of HLA genes in basepair

Author

Xiuwen Zheng

Examples

hlaLociInfo()
#> using the default genome assembly (assembly="hg38")
#>                name chrom    start      end suggest.pos
